title: Sequence synchronization tasks, microtasks and timers
goal: Observe that the Promise callback is executed after the current synchronization code and before the timer callback.
summary: diagnostic button will arrange three types of operations. The log shows the actual execution sequence of the same click.
tasks: After clicking #run, write "synchronization" as the first item. Use Promise.resolve().then to schedule "microtask" and setTimeout to schedule "timer".
When all three items are executed, let #order display "synchronization → microtask → timer". Each click is recorded individually.

example.note: 0 millisecond timer will also wait for the current task to end. Enqueued Promise microtasks are processed earlier.

hint: creates a new array in the click callback, and updates the page after each addition through a dedicated recording function.
